attchmntText: Khazanchi Jewellers Limited has submitted the Exchange a copy Srutinizers report of  Extraordinary General Meeting held on November 17, 2026. Further, the company has informed the Exchange regarding voting results.
voiceSummary: Khazanchi Jewellers Limited reports the voting results for its Extra Ordinary General Meeting held on November 17, 2026. The company passed a Special Resolution appointing Ms. Simran Lodha, DIN 11898979, as Non-Executive cum Independent Director for a three-year term effective August 18, 2026. The resolution received requisite majority support. Voting was conducted via remote e-Voting and e-Voting at the meeting. Promoters and Promoter Group voted in favor with 100 percent support. Public Non-Institutions voted 99.80 percent in favor. Total votes polled were 17,690,451 out of 24,746,900 shares held by shareholders on the record date of November 11, 2026. One shareholder holding 585 shares had invalid votes due to missing authorization. The Consolidated Scrutinizer Report was issued by Mr. Balu Sridhar of M/s A K Jain & Associates on November 18, 2026.

attchmntText: Khazanchi Jewellers Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Audio recording
voiceSummary: Khazanchi Jewellers Limited has submitted the audio recording of its investor conference call regarding financial results for Q2FY27 and H1FY27 to BSE Limited and NSE. The recording is available on the company website. Mr. Rajesh Mehta, Chairman and Joint Managing Director, attended the meeting. The company confirms that no unpublished price sensitive information was shared during the call.

attchmntText: Khazanchi Jewellers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Proceedings of Extraordinary General Meeting held on November 17, 2026
voiceSummary: Khazanchi Jewellers Limited held an Extra-Ordinary General Meeting on November 17, 2026, to consider the appointment of Ms. Simran Lodha, DIN 11898979, as Non-Executive cum Independent Director for a term of three years with effect from August 18, 2026. The item was proposed as a Special Resolution. Voting was conducted via remote e-Voting from November 14, 2026, to November 16, 2026, and during the meeting through CDSL. M/s A K Jain & Associates acted as the Scrutinizer. The results of the e-Voting, along with the Scrutinizer’s Report, are awaited and will be declared within two working days. The resolution is subject to shareholder approval.

attchmntText: Khazanchi Jewellers Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Khazanchi Jewellers Limited submitted an investor presentation for Q2 and H1 FY27 to BSE and NSE. H1 FY27 revenue reached 1,191.29 Cr, up 25.1% year on year. EBITDA rose 49.6% to 80.46 Cr with a margin of 6.75%. Profit after tax grew 47.1% to 56.91 Cr. In Q2, revenue increased 10.4% to 605.67 Cr. EBITDA grew 24.1% to 40.48 Cr. PAT rose 23.6% to 29.09 Cr. Retail sales grew 3.3 times year on year. The company migrated to the Main Boards of BSE and NSE on 27th October 2026. Net worth increased by 55.6 Cr to 375.18 Cr. Borrowings remained flat at 114.27 Cr. The company targets 5,000 Cr in revenue by 2030.

attchmntText: Khazanchi Jewellers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 14, 2026, titled "Press release".
voiceSummary: Khazanchi Jewellers Limited filed a press release regarding its unaudited financial results for Q2 and H1 FY27 ended September 30, 2026. Revenue for Q2 FY27 was Rs. 605.58 crore, up 10.39% year-on-year, with EBITDA at Rs. 40.48 crore and PAT at Rs. 29.09 crore. For H1 FY27, revenue reached Rs. 1,191.29 crore, up 25.09%, with EBITDA at Rs. 80.46 crore and PAT at Rs. 56.91 crore. The company noted strong growth driven by its retail business and cost control. This filing marks the first results since the shares moved to the Main Boards of BSE and NSE.

attchmntText: Khazanchi Jewellers Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates-Policy revision
voiceSummary: Khazanchi Jewellers Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 14, 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, along with the Limited Review Report by Statutory Auditors. The Board also adopted revised policies to align with SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015 and SEBI Prohibition of Insider Trading Regulations, 2015. These policies include the Code of Conduct for Board Members and Senior Management Personnel, Code of Conduct for Designated Persons, Board Diversity Policy, Corporate Social Responsibility Policy, Policy for Determining Material Subsidiaries, Nomination and Remuneration Policy, Risk Management Policy, Policy on Prevention of Sexual Harassment at workplace, Whistle Blower Policy, and updated contact details of Key Managerial Personnel. The meeting commenced at 12.15 PM and concluded at 12.55 PM IST. The information is available on the company website www.khazanchi.co.in.
